findings.summary: The Withheld branch of SyncCards (unreadable page, no own page) and the pagesErr branch (every eligible memory counted as Failed) have no test.
evidence: sync_cards.go:61-64 sets Failed for every eligible memory when pagesErr != nil; sync_cards.go:78-80 sets Withheld.
sync_cards_test.go:50-262 holds eight tests; none writes an unreadable page or makes ListPages fail.

findings.summary: A cardUpdate ending in ActionSkippedLocalEdit is appended to Promoted, while the CardSyncReport doc says Promoted lists memories the run wrote a page for; Engram Sync appends the same way, but doc and behavior disagree and no test covers a local-edit skip in a sync.
evidence: card.go:203-211 returns the skip action with no write.
card.go at 623387c7 against the pre-split PromoteCard and scanCardPages: same results and error text on the explicit path.
Decision order unchanged: bridged, own, unreadable, create.
scanFor and the old scan agree on own and byCardID; bridge ranking unchanged.
noteAddress after each write lets later memories link a page created earlier; own is keyed by unique id, so no duplicate page.
decideCard revision comparison covered at sync_cards_test.go:71, 103, 192.
store.go:83-171 ListMemories and MemoryByID share memorySelect, scanMemory and bridgeOf; store_test.go:93-142 pins archived and other-project exclusion.
sync_cards_test.go:221-244 counts ListPages calls; :164-189 covers bridging by import_map and by same content.
